property_summary: For any admissible deposit b and reentrant deposit a, a withdraw whose callee re-enters addToBalance must revert (the reentrancy lock blocks the nested deposit, which fails the callee and forces withdrawBalance to revert); the mutant drops the lock, the nested deposit succeeds, the withdraw completes, so the call no longer reverts for some (b,a).
change_summary: Remove the lock acquisition so reentrant calls are no longer blocked, allowing reentrant addToBalance to update balances in sequences the original reverts on.
